attributes.title: autoRIFT surface velocities
attributes.author: Alex S. Gardner, JPL/NASA; Yang Lei, GPS/Caltech
attributes.institution: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), California Institute of Technology
attributes.source: NASA MEaSUREs ITS_LIVE project. Processed by ASF DAAC HyP3 2026 using the hyp3_autorift plugin version 0.28.4 running autoRIFT version 2.1.1 using ISCE3 version 0.25.0-dev+6116cdac. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed by ESA
attributes.references:
When using this data, please acknowledge the source (see global source attribute) and cite:
* Gardner, A. S., Moholdt, G., Scambos, T., Fahnestock, M., Ligtenberg, S., van den Broeke, M.,
  and Nilsson, J., 2018. Increased West Antarctic and unchanged East Antarctic ice discharge over
  the last 7 years. The Cryosphere, 12, p.521. https://doi.org/10.5194/tc-12-521-2018
* Lei, Y., Gardner, A. and Agram, P., 2021. Autonomous Repeat Image Feature Tracking (autoRIFT)
  and Its Application for Tracking Ice Displacement. Remote Sensing, 13(4), p.749.
  https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13040749

Additionally, DOI's are provided for the software used to generate this data:
* autoRIFT: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4025445
* HyP3 autoRIFT plugin: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4037016
* HyP3 processing environment: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3962581

vx.description: velocity component in x direction from radar range and azimuth measurements
vx.error_description: best estimate of x_velocity error: vx_error is populated according to the approach used for the velocity bias correction as indicated in "stable_shift_flag"
vx.error_stationary_description: RMSE over stable surfaces, stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year identified from an external mask
vx.error_modeled_description: 1-sigma error calculated using a modeled error-dt relationship
vx.error_slow_description: RMSE over slowest 25% of retrieved velocities
vx.stable_shift_flag_description: flag for applying velocity bias correction: 0 = no correction; 1 = correction from overlapping stable surface mask (stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year)(top priority); 2 = correction from slowest 25% of overlapping velocities (second priority)

vy.description: velocity component in y direction from radar range and azimuth measurements
vy.error_description: best estimate of y_velocity error: vy_error is populated according to the approach used for the velocity bias correction as indicated in "stable_shift_flag"
vy.error_stationary_description: RMSE over stable surfaces, stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year identified from an external mask
vy.error_modeled_description: 1-sigma error calculated using a modeled error-dt relationship
vy.error_slow_description: RMSE over slowest 25% of retrieved velocities
vy.stable_shift_flag_description: flag for applying velocity bias correction: 0 = no correction; 1 = correction from overlapping stable surface mask (stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year)(top priority); 2 = correction from slowest 25% of overlapping velocities (second priority)

v_error.description: velocity magnitude error from radar range and azimuth measurements

vr.error_description: best estimate of range_velocity error: vr_error is populated according to the approach used for the velocity bias correction as indicated in "stable_shift_flag"
vr.error_stationary_description: RMSE over stable surfaces, stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year identified from an external mask
vr.error_modeled_description: 1-sigma error calculated using a modeled error-dt relationship
vr.error_slow_description: RMSE over slowest 25% of retrieved velocities
vr.stable_shift_flag_description: flag for applying velocity bias correction: 0 = no correction; 1 = correction from overlapping stable surface mask (stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year)(top priority); 2 = correction from slowest 25% of overlapping velocities (second priority)

va.error_description: best estimate of azimuth_velocity error: va_error is populated according to the approach used for the velocity bias correction as indicated in "stable_shift_flag"
va.error_stationary_description: RMSE over stable surfaces, stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year identified from an external mask
va.error_modeled_description: 1-sigma error calculated using a modeled error-dt relationship
va.error_slow_description: RMSE over slowest 25% of retrieved velocities
va.stable_shift_flag_description: flag for applying velocity bias correction: 0 = no correction; 1 = correction from overlapping stable surface mask (stationary or slow-flowing surfaces with velocity < 15 meter/year)(top priority); 2 = correction from slowest 25% of overlapping velocities (second priority)

M11.description: conversion matrix element (1st row, 1st column) that can be multiplied with vx to give range pixel displacement dr (see Eq. A18 in https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/13/4/749)
M11.dr_to_vr_factor_description: multiplicative factor that converts slant range pixel displacement dr to slant range velocity vr

M12.description: conversion matrix element (1st row, 2nd column) that can be multiplied with vy to give range pixel displacement dr (see Eq. A18 in https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/13/4/749)
M12.dr_to_vr_factor_description: multiplicative factor that converts slant range pixel displacement dr to slant range velocity vr

chip_size_width.chip_size_coordinates: radar geometry: width = range, height = azimuth

chip_size_height.chip_size_coordinates: radar geometry: width = range, height = azimuth

interp_mask.description: true where values have been interpolated

time.description: mid-date between acquisition_date_img1 and acquisition_date_img2 with microseconds added to ensure uniqueness.
